Each operador's response layout is proprietary and is obtained from the chosen information operator at implementation - it has no published national standard, so this workbook carries no field-level specification for it.

An employee with no pay in the month is reported with the change event that explains it - SLN with its date pair and reduced day counts, as in the row 'Employee on unpaid leave for the whole month'.

edits.current: Closed list CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, RC, PE, PT (PT = Permiso por Protección Temporal). PE may not be used for health contribution periods from September 2023 onwards. An ALPHANUMERIC identification number is permitted only for PA and CD; for TI, CC, SC, RC, CE, PE and PT the number must be all digits. NOTE the divergence from the electronic payroll, which uses NUMERIC codes (13 = CC) rather than these two-letter codes - the engine must MAP, not copy. Bidirectional set with 'Foreign national not liable to contribute to pension' (T2R2-007), which where marked restricts this field to CE, PA, CD, SC, PE or PT, and with 'Colombian abroad' (T2R2-008), which is used only where this field is CC or TI. COMPOSITE KEY: together with T2R2-004 (Contributor identification number), this pair is the join key for the contributor across every Colombian artefact -- electronic payroll NIE044/NIE045, Form 220 casillas 24/25, Format 2276 numeral 2 -- matching the same pair convention documented on CO-SEVERANCE SAVINGS-006 T03/T04. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campos 3, 7 and 8. Source: Master Data holds no document-type field. Derive the type from the populated document column: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> CC; 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> CE. The precedence rule where more than one document column is populated, and the PILA codes for the columns 'National ID' and 'Identity Card', are configuration parameters supplied at implementation (document-column to PILA document-type mapping table). An employee with no document column populated is rejected as a blocking data error.

edits.current: A one-off variation in the contribution base for this period only - typically a bonus or a retroactive payment - that does not change the standing salary. Mark VST when the period's contribution base differs from the standing contractual salary because of salary-constituting variable payments (e.g. WT 62133 Variable, 62150 Vacation Bonus, 62207 Attendance Bonus). The list of wage types that trigger VST is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation (VST trigger wage-type table).
edits.proposed: A one-off variation in the contribution base for this period only - typically a bonus or a retroactive payment - that does not change the standing salary. Mark VST when the period's contribution base differs from the standing contractual salary because of salary-constituting variable payments (e.g. WT 62133 Variable, 62150 Vacation Bonus, 62207 Attendance Bonus). A wage type triggers VST where it is salary-constituting and variable (not part of the standing salary); the salary-constituting and variable attributes of each wage type come from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC).

edits.current: Tipo de salario. X = salario integral; F = salario fijo; V = salario variable. Where X, the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary (the remaining 30% is the statutory prestacional factor; CST art. 132 num. 2, minimum 13 SMMLV). Maps to electronic payroll SalarioIntegral (NIE056) for the X case. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campo 41 and §2.1.2.3.40. Source: Master Data holds no salary-type field; X where the employee is paid WT 62140 Integral Salary in the period, F where paid WT 62100 Ordinary Salary. Rule to be set at implementation: the condition under which V (salario variable) is reported. Where X, the 70% applies to the CCF base (T2R2-045) and to the parafiscal base (T2R2-095) as well as to the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC (CST art. 132; Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49; WT 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual' carries the 70% of the integral salary).

edits.current: Contribution base for pension. FLOOR 1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905; CEILING 25 SMMLV = COP 43,772,625 in 2026. Must reconcile to electronic payroll NIE166 divided by the rate in T2R2-046, allowing for the different rounding conventions. Bidirectional set with 'All-inclusive salary flag' (T2R2-041), which where marked sets this base to 70% of the all-inclusive salary, and with 'Solidarity pension fund - solidarity sub-account' (T2R2-051), which is payable only where this base reaches 4 SMMLV. Computation order: (a) salary-constituting pay of the period (70% of it for an integral salary); (b) plus the excess of non-salary payments over 40% of TOTAL remuneration (Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30) - rule to be set at implementation: for an integral salary, whether the 40% test is run on the full integral salary or on its 70% base, and whether the excess is added in full on top of the 70% base; (c) floor 1 SMMLV, ceiling 25 SMMLV; (d) round UP to the whole peso (the payroll intermediate value may carry decimals, e.g. 17300699.5). Source: payroll field 'IBC Total' (the base on which WT 2556 Pension Plan Mandatory - AFP Employee, 4%, is computed); WT 64995 'Non-SSI excess' holds the Ley 1393 de 2010 add-back.

edits.current: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling. Vacation and paid-leave (VAC-LR) days do not reduce the ARL day count (T2R2-038) because they are paid; maternity or paternity leave days (LMA = X) carry no occupational-risk contribution (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6). Rule to be set at implementation: how general-illness incapacity (IGE) days enter the ARL base and the ARL day count.

edits.current: TOTAL pension rate - employer 12% plus employee 4% = 16% (Law 100 of 1993 art. 20 as substituted by Law 797 of 2003 art. 7). HARD RULE from the annex: where 'Contributor sub-type' (T2R2-006) is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 or 12, THIS FIELD MUST BE 0. A high-risk employee under Decree-Law 2090 of 2003 carries an additional employer charge (scope_manifest CO-GAP-02); the high-risk rate is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation. Bidirectional pair with 'Special pension rate indicator' (T2R2-079), which is populated wherever a non-standard rate - notably a Decree-Law 2090 of 2003 high-risk rate - replaces the standard 16%.

edits.current: THE PER-EMPLOYEE, PER-MONTH SIDE of the ET art. 114-1 exoneration (introduced by Ley 1607 de 2012 and confirmed by Ley 1819 de 2016 art. 65). Values are S and N, not X. The employer-level flag in A1-033 declares eligibility; THIS field applies it to a specific employee in a specific month. TWO RULES APPLY TOGETHER. (1) The exoneration test is on the TOTAL EARNINGS of the month (total devengado): the employee is exonerated where the total devengado of the month is below 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026) - Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7. It is an earnings test, NOT a test on the health IBC. (2) In addition, AT2 v30 campo 76 requires N whenever the health contribution base in campo 43 (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV. The field is therefore S only where BOTH the total devengado and the health IBC are below 10 SMMLV. The test is monthly, so an employee who crosses 10 SMMLV because of a bonus loses the exoneration for that month alone - the engine must evaluate it every period, never once a year. Where marked S, the employer's health 8.5%, SENA 2% and ICBF 3% fall away and the health rate in T2R2-054 becomes the EMPLOYEE rate alone (4%); pension, occupational risk and the CCF 4% remain payable in full. The wage types that compose the total devengado for this test are a configuration parameter supplied at implementation.
